list.name: servicio
list.label: Servicio
list.query: PABELLON,SERVICIO CLINICO CIRUGIA,SERVICIO GINECOLOGIA,SERVICIO OBSTETRICIA,SERVICIO OBSTETRICIA Y GINECOLOGIA

panels.title: Cadena de abastecimiento — base Ene-Ago 2026 (el filtro Mes no aplica aquí)

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(pac_inicial_eneago) AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(pac_modificado_eneago) AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(cant_solicitada) AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(cant_despachada) AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(pac_modificado_eneago)/NULLIF(SUM(pac_inicial_eneago),0)-1 AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(cant_despachada)/NULLIF(SUM(cant_solicitada),0) AS v FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})

SELECT servicio,
       SUM(pac_inicial_eneago)    AS "PAC inicial",
       SUM(pac_modificado_eneago) AS "PAC modificado",
       SUM(cant_solicitada)       AS "Solicitado",
       SUM(cant_despachada)       AS "Despachado"
FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) GROUP BY servicio ORDER BY servicio

panels.title: Situación de los ítems de la cadena

targets.rawSql:
SELECT situacion, COUNT(*) AS n_items
FROM cadena_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) GROUP BY situacion ORDER BY n_items DESC

panels.title: Planificación — PAC inicial vs. modificado (base anual Ene-Dic; el filtro Mes no aplica)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio",
       n_items_inicial AS "Ítems inicial", n_items_modificado AS "Ítems modif.",
       n_incorporados AS "Incorp.", n_eliminados AS "Elim.",
       n_aumentaron AS "Aumentaron", n_disminuyeron AS "Disminuyeron", n_sin_cambio AS "Sin cambio",
       cant_inicial AS "Cant. inicial", cant_modificado AS "Cant. modif.",
       diferencia_neta AS "Dif. neta", variacion_neta_pct AS "Var. neta %",
       pct_items_modificados AS "% ítems modif."
FROM v_pac_reprogramacion WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) ORDER BY variacion_neta_pct DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Variación neta del PAC por servicio (%)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio, variacion_neta_pct AS "Variación neta %"
FROM v_pac_reprogramacion WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) ORDER BY servicio

SELECT servicio,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tipo_cambio='Sin cambio')            AS "Sin cambio",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tipo_cambio='Aumentó')               AS "Aumentó",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tipo_cambio='Disminuyó')             AS "Disminuyó",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tipo_cambio LIKE 'Incorporado%')     AS "Incorporado",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tipo_cambio LIKE 'Eliminado%')       AS "Eliminado"
FROM pac_item WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) GROUP BY servicio ORDER BY servicio

options.content: Usá el filtro **Servicio** de arriba para ver **una unidad a la vez**. Con «All» seleccionado, el gráfico de líneas muestra una línea por servicio; el resto de los paneles suman los servicios elegidos.

panels.title: Cumplimiento de despacho por mes y servicio

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', periodo) AS time,
       servicio AS metric,
       ROUND(SUM(cant_despachada) / NULLIF(SUM(cant_solicitada), 0), 4) AS "Cumplimiento"
FROM despacho_mensual WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, servicio ORDER BY 1, servicio

panels.title: Solicitado vs. Despachado por mes (suma de los servicios elegidos)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(periodo,'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
       SUM(cant_solicitada) AS "Solicitado",
       SUM(cant_despachada) AS "Despachado"
FROM despacho_mensual WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
GROUP BY periodo ORDER BY periodo

SELECT to_char(periodo,'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
       SUM(cant_solicitada) - SUM(cant_despachada) AS "Brecha"
FROM despacho_mensual WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
GROUP BY periodo ORDER BY periodo

SELECT bodega AS "Bodega",
       SUM(cant_solicitada) AS "Solicitado",
       SUM(cant_despachada) AS "Despachado",
       SUM(cant_solicitada)-SUM(cant_despachada) AS "Brecha",
       ROUND(SUM(cant_despachada)/NULLIF(SUM(cant_solicitada),0),4) AS "Cumplimiento %"
FROM despacho_mensual WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote}) GROUP BY bodega ORDER BY bodega

SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", n_lineas AS "N° líneas",
       n_lineas_con_brecha AS "Líneas c/brecha",
       solicitado AS "Solicitado", despachado AS "Despachado",
       cumplimiento_pct AS "Cumplimiento %", pct_lineas_con_brecha AS "% líneas c/brecha"
FROM v_despacho_servicio WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) ORDER BY cumplimiento_pct

options.content: **Lectura con cuidado (Notas_Metodológicas):** este listado son solicitudes **aún abiertas/editables** (cola de trabajo en curso), no el universo histórico. No hay fechas de cierre/adjudicación → el único tiempo medible es **Creación → Asignación a Ejecutivo** (52/91 casos). Montos: solo los marcados confiables. **Servicio Clínico Cirugía = 2 solicitudes** (base insuficiente).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es_problematica)::numeric/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS v FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
SELECT AVG(dias_hasta_asignacion) AS v FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
SELECT SUM(monto_limpio) FILTER (WHERE monto_confiable) AS v FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cerrada) AS v FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})

SELECT estado_categoria AS "Estado",
       COUNT(*) AS "N°",
       ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric/NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),0),4) AS "% del total",
       SUM(monto_limpio) FILTER (WHERE monto_confiable) AS "Monto confiable $",
       ROUND(AVG(dias_hasta_asignacion),1) AS "Días prom. asignación"
FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote}) GROUP BY estado_categoria ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT to_char(periodo,'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='Compra Iniciada')        AS "Compra Iniciada",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='En proceso (derivada)')  AS "En proceso",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='Pendiente de aprobación') AS "Pendiente aprob.",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='Devuelta')               AS "Devuelta",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='Anulada')                AS "Anulada",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_categoria='Rechazada')              AS "Rechazada"
FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
GROUP BY periodo ORDER BY periodo

SELECT atribucion AS causa, COUNT(*) AS "N° solicitudes"
FROM compra WHERE es_problematica AND atribucion IS NOT NULL AND servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote})
GROUP BY atribucion ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", COUNT(*) AS "N°",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es_problematica) AS "Problemáticas",
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es_problematica)::numeric/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),4) AS "% problem.",
       SUM(monto_limpio) FILTER (WHERE monto_confiable) AS "Monto confiable $"
FROM compra WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote}) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM periodo)::int::text IN (${mes:singlequote}) GROUP BY servicio ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: Ítems críticos (base Ene-Ago; el filtro Mes no aplica)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción",
       pac_inicial_eneago AS "PAC inicial", pac_modificado_eneago AS "PAC modif.",
       cant_solicitada AS "Solicitado",
       var_pct_ini_mod AS "Var% Ini→Mod", var_pct_mod_sol AS "Var% Mod→Sol"
FROM v_items_criticos WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY magnitud_cambio DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Mayor brecha de despacho (demanda no satisfecha, unidades)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción", um AS "UM",
       cant_solicitada AS "Solicitado", cant_despachada AS "Despachado",
       brecha_despacho AS "Brecha", cumplimiento_pct AS "Cumplimiento %",
       valor_brecha_estimado AS "Valor brecha $ (ref)"
FROM v_items_brecha_despacho WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY brecha_despacho DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Ítems de mayor valor económico (precio ref × cantidad, Ene-Ago)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción", um AS "UM",
       precio_ref AS "Precio ref $", pac_modificado_eneago AS "PAC modif.",
       cant_solicitada AS "Solicitado", cant_despachada AS "Despachado",
       valor_pac_modificado AS "Valor PAC modif. $", valor_solicitado AS "Valor solicitado $",
       valor_despachado AS "Valor despachado $"
FROM v_items_valor WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY valor_pac_modificado DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Solicitados muy por encima del PAC modificado (≥30%, con volumen)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción", um AS "UM",
       pac_modificado_eneago AS "PAC modif.", cant_solicitada AS "Solicitado",
       desv_solicitud_vs_mod AS "Desv. abs", desv_pct_solicitud_vs_mod AS "Desv. %",
       cumplimiento_pct AS "Cumplimiento %"
FROM v_items_sobre_solicitud WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY desv_pct_solicitud_vs_mod DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción", um AS "UM",
       pac_inicial_eneago AS "PAC inicial", pac_modificado_eneago AS "PAC modif.",
       valor_pac_modificado AS "Valor PAC modif. $ (ref)"
FROM v_items_plan_no_solicitado WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY pac_modificado_eneago DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Quiebre de stock recurrente (brecha de despacho en 3+ meses)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción", um AS "UM",
       meses_con_brecha AS "Meses c/brecha", meses_con_movimiento AS "Meses c/mov.",
       solicitado_total AS "Solicitado", despachado_total AS "Despachado",
       brecha_acumulada AS "Brecha acum.", cumplimiento_pct AS "Cumplimiento %"
FROM v_items_quiebre_recurrente WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY meses_con_brecha DESC, brecha_acumulada DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Demanda no planificada (solicitado sin estar en ningún PAC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT servicio AS "Servicio", codigo_cgcom AS "Código", descripcion AS "Descripción",
       um AS "UM", cant_solicitada AS "Solicitado", cant_despachada AS "Despachado",
       cumplimiento_pct AS "Cumplimiento %"
FROM v_demanda_no_planificada WHERE servicio IN (${servicio:singlequote})
ORDER BY cant_solicitada DESC LIMIT 60
